## What's changed

- Added verified local-media details for supported players, including resolution, Dolby Vision/HDR, video codec, audio format, Atmos, and channel layout.
- Cached technical media details in the local library index and added a seamless background upgrade for existing indexes without interrupting library browsing.
- Applied the resumed episode's media details to Continue Watching series cards and kept primary English, non-commentary audio metadata as the default.
- Simplified local media configuration by hiding the unfinished inline artwork editors while preserving their artwork data and APIs for a future dedicated settings experience.
- Replaced the large custom-channel bumper card with a compact multi-select dropdown beside the commercial selector.
